The '''Jandolhoon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was the location of [[Daxis Outpost]], a base used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|Scout Service]].
